text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Since today's training is with Hayahide, 
I'm gonna go all-out and smash it~!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket... I know I said I would pace with 
you, but even my stamina has its limits...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"At any rate, we should take a break soon. 
At this rate, you risk overworking 
yourself."

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm still totally fine! Look, suddenly 
my body feels super light――

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
A... Amaaazing!! I'm floating! I'm 
floating in midairーー!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
And, and! You can run on it just like the 
ground! It's super fluffy, but you can 
zoom right across it!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight! Let's zoom right through the 
blue sky like this, KABOOOM! All the way 
to the sparkling sun, BAM-BAM-BAAAM!!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ticket! Hey, Ticket! Pull yourself 
together! Wake up!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... Trainer and Hayahide? Why are you 
two in such a panic, what's wrong...?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Anyone would panic if you collapsed out of 
nowhere like that. I'm just glad it's 
nothing serious, but...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
“—O-Oh yeah! Guess what! Guess what! My 
heart was beating super fast!”

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
It's so fluffy, so fast, it's the absolute 
best! I feel like I could blast off right 
now~!

Ever since that incident, Winning Ticket's 
running was somehow sharpened to a fine 
edge...
